earnings.title: PUBLIC STORAGE REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND RAISES GUIDANCE

quotes.text: Public Storage’s third quarter performance was better than expected and demonstrates the strength and scalability of our platform as well as improving industry fundamentals.

outlook: Increased outlook for the full-year 2026, including Same Store NOI by 90bps and Core FFO per share by $0.10, following strong year-to-date performance and reaffirming optimism for the remainder of 2026.
